meta.name: loop-engineering
meta.description: Turn a repeatable task into a bounded, evidence-driven agent loop. Use when Codex needs to decide whether a task merits a Goal, Loop, Automation, or AutoResearch pattern; define a loop contract; check trigger/state/tools/codebase readiness; choose single-agent versus maker-checker versus manager-workers topology; prevent runaway iteration; or repair a loop that stalls, self-grades, exceeds review budget, or writes without verified evidence.
